shared_elements: horizontal composition running across the surface
justification: The only real overlap is that both include a quadruped in profile and human presence within a horizontally extended scene; A is a highly schematic silhouette boat with a row of stroke-like crew members and a tiny stick animal, while B is a densely modelled naturalistic battle/hunt scene with overlapping horses, chariots with spoked wheels, and anatomically detailed figures. The conventions of depiction (flat abstract line-silhouette vs modelled relief with foreshortening and overlap) and the subject matter (a manned ship vs wheeled vehicles and fallen bodies) share nothing distinctive.
